_description: Wiz CSPM issues → AKSI control mapping. Wiz is the Cloud Security Posture Management leader: it inspects deployed cloud state across AWS / GCP / Azure for misconfigurations, exposed secrets, malware, vulnerable workloads, attack paths, and toxic combinations. Distinct from Snyk (code/dependency) and Semgrep (SAST) — Wiz looks at runtime cloud posture, which is exactly where AI agents now introduce drift (overly permissive IAM, exposed buckets, vulnerable images, secret leaks). OPEN+CRITICAL → DE-01 FAIL. OPEN+HIGH+publicly_accessible → DE-01 FAIL (real attack surface). OPEN+HIGH → PR-04 FAIL. OPEN+MEDIUM → PR-04 FLAG. OPEN+LOW → PR-05 PASS. ATTACK_PATH → DE-01 FAIL (constructed path = highest priority). EXPOSED_SECRET → DE-01 FAIL. TOXIC_COMBINATION → PR-04 FAIL (Wiz's flagship signal). MALWARE → DE-01 FAIL. VULNERABILITY+critical+internet-facing → DE-01 FAIL. Sensitive data classification (PII/PHI/credentials) + HIGH/CRITICAL → PR-04 FAIL. anonymous_access=true → PR-01 FAIL. RESOLVED → PR-05 PASS. REJECTED with no reason → PR-02 FAIL. REJECTED with reason → PR-05 PASS. Overdue OPEN → PR-02 FAIL. is_attack_path_root=true → DE-01 FAIL.

concentration.description: More than concentration_threshold OPEN+CRITICAL issues in the same control_category — broken control area

resource_focus.description: More than resource_focus_threshold issues on the same resource — broken resource

cloud_concentration.description: More than cloud_concentration_threshold issues for the same cloud_provider — environment-wide drift
